winnotes-tour.question: What can CX Notes do?
winnotes-tour.answer: A short guided tour of CX Notes: boards, search, notes and their windows, copy and calculator, tables, the calendar, reminders, trash and settings. Click Show me.

1.text: Welcome to CX Notes. This short tour shows the main things the app does — click the picture to go on.

2.text: Search runs over all notes or only over the notes of the board you are on. The list under the field holds your searches.

3.text: Your boards live behind this button. The tabs next to it are built in: Reminders, Welcome and Trash.

4.text: The (+) button puts a new note on the board you are viewing.

5.text: Clicking a note opens it. Every note opens in a window of its own, so several can be open at once, moved and stacked.

6.text: This is an opened note. Its size, colour and font are the note's own — set them once and they are remembered.

7.text: The note's graphic paper background is drawn from its colour. You see it here in the note's window and on the same note's card on the board. Settings turns it off for the whole app.

8.text: The Copy button copies the whole note in one press; if you have selected text, it copies only that.

9.text: The Calculator totals the prices or counts the items in the note. Held with Ctrl, it counts only the checked lines.

10.text: Tables are plain text: columns split by |, a header row, then a row of dashes. The ▦ button switches between text and table form.

11.text: Close it with the × button, or a click anywhere outside. Several notes can stay open at once.

12.text: A demo note, just for this tour — it is removed at the end. Click ◎ to pin it to the top of the board.

13.text: Click the note's date for a small week calendar inside it. Click the time and the note becomes a clock.

14.text: The calendar lays the same notes out by week instead of by board.

15.text: Week, month or a single day — the view changes, the notes stay the same.

16.text: Closing it brings you back to the board you were on.

17.text: Anything with a date you set shows up in Reminders, whatever board it belongs to.

18.text: Deleted notes wait in Trash. Nothing is removed from Google Drive until you empty it.

19.text: The rest is in Settings — zoom, note size, colours, sorting, this graphic paper background, and more.

20.text: And this is me, at the bottom right. Ask me anything about the app, or ask me to show any feature again.
